newsitem.title: USA: Helionetics bankruptcy filing by creditors.
newsitem.headline: Helionetics bankruptcy filing by creditors.

text.p: Helionetics Inc said Thursday it has learned that certain of its creditors have filed a motion for involuntary Chapter 7 bankruptcy proceedings against it.
Bankruptcy court papers have not been served on the company and has thus been unable to assess the situation or determine what its response will be, the company said in a statement.
It said that counsel for the company's creditors had confirmed that the motion had been filed.
